physicalNotes: No radius or mass of M37 is recorded: it is an extended star cluster, and its package frames it at 12.4 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), Hunt & Reffert's tidal radius estimate, a presentation value.

sources.position: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2099: RA_ICRS 88.08008221, DE_ICRS 32.54084466, the densest point of its members (epoch 2016.0) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
sources.distance: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II.
